title: LLMs in DevSecOps: A Systematic Mapping of Models, Evidence, and Research Gaps Across the Software Lifecycle
abstract: arXiv:2611.18632v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly being integrated into software security and DevSecOps workflows, yet their adoption, evaluation, and maturity vary substantially across lifecycle stages. This study systematically maps recent LLM-enabled security research published between 2024 and 2026 (until June) across six DevSecOps stages: \textit{Plan}, \textit{Code}, \textit{Test}, \textit{Review}, \textit{Deploy}, and \textit{Monitor}. For each stage, we analyze the security tasks addressed, models and adaptation strategies employed, evaluation settings, reported effectiveness, and key limitations. Our findings reveal an uneven research landscape, with \textit{Test} and \textit{Code} receiving substantially greater attention than \textit{Deploy} and \textit{Review}. translated_title: DevSecOps中的大语言模型：软件生命周期中模型、证据与研究空白的系统性映射
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）正日益被整合到软件安全与DevSecOps工作流中，但其在生命周期各阶段的采用、评估和成熟度差异显著。本研究系统性地梳理了2024年至2026年（截至6月）发表的近期基于LLM的安全研究，涵盖六个DevSecOps阶段：计划、编码、测试、审查、部署和监控。针对每个阶段，我们分析了所解决的安全任务、所采用的模型与适配策略、评估设置、报告的有效性以及关键局限性。研究发现揭示了一个不均衡的研究格局：测试和编码阶段受到的关注远多于部署和审查阶段。纵观各阶段，近期的系统越来越多地依赖结构化上下文、迭代推理、微调、检索增强或智能体工作流，而非直接的单一推理方式。
tldr: 本文对2024–2026年间LLM在DevSecOps六大阶段（计划、编码、测试、审查、部署、监控）的安全应用研究进行了系统性映射，揭示出研究分布不均衡——测试与编码阶段受到的关注远超部署与审查阶段，且近期系统日益依赖结构化上下文、迭代推理、微调、检索增强与智能体工作流等适配策略。
en_tdlr: This study systematically maps LLM-enabled security research (2024–2026) across six DevSecOps stages, revealing an uneven research landscape where Test and Code attract far more attention than Deploy and Review, and showing that recent systems increasingly rely on structured context, iterative reasoning, fine-tuning, retrieval augmentation, or agentic workflows.
